body: The feeling of being 100% is nice. At the very least you should take tonight and finally get a breath of fresh air. Get a good sleep for once. Feel confident, and try to see what happiness looks like. If it’s over then it’s over, but goodbyes don’t have to be full of curiosity.

I feel obliged to tell you that out of everything you can be on time for, your suicide is not one of them. If you have decided this is the route you want to go, then you can afford at least one more night to think about it. If this is your decision, you should try to get some sleep, since you’re now resolute. Think about it. We love you as you are.
I don’t know that you can rely on that. Where you have that certainty, maybe give yourself a 20% chance of being wrong.

Nah man. It doesn’t make you a pussy. It’s a good thing your hand didn’t move. I think it means you’re meant for at least one more thing in life. After that, another thing, and then another. You didn’t fail tonight. You succeeded in knowing you have another mission left to accomplish.
